code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query mean AQHI for weekdays 2025-01-20 to 2025-01-24 (inclusive)
query_weekday = text("""
SELECT AVG(aqhi::float) as weekday_mean_aqhi
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 15
  AND datetime >= '2025-01-20 00:00:00'
  AND datetime < '2025-01-25 00:00:00'
""")

# Query mean AQHI for weekend 2025-01-25 to 2025-01-26 (inclusive)
query_weekend = text("""
SELECT AVG(aqhi::float) as weekend_mean_aqhi
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 15
  AND datetime >= '2025-01-25 00:00:00'
  AND datetime < '2025-01-27 00:00:00'
""")

weekday_result = pd.read_sql(query_weekday, engine)
weekend_result = pd.read_sql(query_weekend, engine)

weekday_mean_aqhi = float(weekday_result['weekday_mean_aqhi'].iloc[0])
weekend_mean_aqhi = float(weekend_result['weekend_mean_aqhi'].iloc[0])

print(f"Weekday mean AQHI (Jan 20-24): {weekday_mean_aqhi:.2f}")
print(f"Weekend mean AQHI (Jan 25-26): {weekend_mean_aqhi:.2f}")
